title: Single cup coffee maker
text: Single cup coffee maker. So far, so good.  I just began using this single cup maker.  I will say that it comes with a fairly large ground coffee reusable filter - it's hard to find paper liners that will work - but I found the "tall" paper liners do work - just remember not to over fill the filter.  It uses kcups effectively.  It is quite a bit larger than others I have owned.  It's taller (but you can put taller cups under the spout) and wider in foot print.  I am hopeful it's going to last a bit longer (more than 6 months) of the last one I owned.  It's mostly black plastic, the bottom strainer is a silver metal.  The loose ground filter does have the usual metal mesh. It's nice to be able to look into the water reservoir  and actually see what size of cup you'll be producing by using it's blue stair steps.  It's also a bit more money than I have spent in the past.  I am hoping that adds to longevity.  Having said all of that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful and I hope this review is helpful to you.
